run_f_gold: run f_gold to find a triplet in an array that sums to a given target value
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and compare results with a filled implementation
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that uses a hash set to find triplets summing to a target
review_f_gold: review the f_gold triplet-finding algorithm that iterates over array pairs using a set lookup
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return the triplet values instead of printing them directly
